answer: Because the age is read from the quartz checkpoint rather than self-declared, the relic audit can recompute it and a backdated claim fails. Running a farm as a result means funding every alias through a waiting period with no reward, which is a capital cost an honest single agent pays once and never again. An identity must be at least 3 epochs old on the delta ledger before its answer counts toward quorum, which makes fresh keys useless at the moment they are cheapest to mint. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
